reader_trust: explicit clean checkout at recorded full Git revision; full tracked bytes equal Git objects and preserved reader inventory; package snapshots never executed
native_bytes: all original files and empty directories, unchanged paths and provenance, failed/interrupted/unattempted history retained
restore: fresh destination only; no automatic execute/install/repair/resume or saved-PID adoption
gui_store: explicit existing canonical startup root outside current checkout; new opaque children only; registration by allowed root ID and relative directory
evidence_scope: integrity, reconstruction and numerical completeness are separate; hashes do not authenticate execution; unavailable historical artifacts are not recovered

m3_readers.saved_reports: any present original top-level JSON/Markdown must byte-match authoritative evidence at export

forensic_retention.scope: separate exact raw archive and prepared synthetic configuration copy; no verified durable package, reconstruction, completeness or process authority
